definitions.explanation: Describes a surface that is very smooth and can be slippery.
Describes the action or sound of slurping noodles.

examples.japanese: {氷|こおり}の{上|うえ}はつるつる{滑|すべ}る。
つるつるの{卵|たまご}の{殻|から}。
うどんをつるつる{食|た}べる。

notes:
つるつる is an onomatopoeic word (擬態語/擬音語) describing smoothness or slurping.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- つるつる{滑|すべ}る: to slide smoothly/be slippery
- つるつる{食|た}べる: to slurp (noodles)
- つるつるの{肌|はだ}: smooth skin

CAN ALSO DESCRIBE: A bald head (つるつるの{頭|あたま}).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- すべすべ: smooth (to touch, pleasant)
- ぬるぬる: slimy, slippery (unpleasant)
